description.value: Broadway Liquor Store is a full-service private liquor store on Vancouver's West Broadway corridor stocking a broad range of beer, wines, and spirits, including rotating craft beer selections. The store caters to special occasions and offers delivery through Uber Eats and Skip the Dishes. For a touring cyclist, it represents a convenient urban stop for resupply of beverages along a major east-west cycling route.
